title: a-red-seal-is-one-trouble-under-one-identity-from-raise-to-clear

decisions.text: One identity per seal trouble, derived by one function at one address inside cairn/devices/tester, called by both the commit ladder (reseal.py) and the validation store's announce/clear. The function is D6's seal_trouble_identity(proof_path) in validation_store.py.
decisions.by: measured 2026-09-15: two emitters, two keys, 90 of 96 identities with raise != clear; Akien's standing 'we need to fix things that come up too. time to ticket those'
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: forward pointer to D6 so D1 reads whole

decisions.text: The ladder emits a clear only for a key that stands raised (in this run, or in the log tree); a green reseal with nothing raised emits nothing. The reader is D7's standing_raises(log_home, recipient=); the check is D7's predicate at the clear site.
decisions.by: measured: seal-red-cairn-tools-base raised 4 / cleared 145 — 141 clears with no raise
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: forward pointer to D7 so D2 reads whole

decisions.text: The identity's GRAIN — per proof or per component — is Akien's call; opened as a question bound to this ticket at cast.
decisions.by: open question open-f998fae25b35; the BUILDME lane holds until answered

decisions.text: The drain host, the trouble store's fold, and the 219 undrained emissions are OUT.
decisions.by: live trouble trouble-drain-has-no-host-the-beat-backstop-is-prose; the hand-run drain is asked in chat under c0e47b140309

decisions.text: D6: THE STORE SPELLS THE SAME KEY. In validation_store.py, announce_verdict_change (:632) and the round-trip green clear in persist_validation (:867) both use seal_trouble_identity(<proof path for the validations path>) where the proof path is Path(path).parent.parent/'proofs'/(stem+'.py'), via a helper _proof_path_for_validations(path). Behaviour is otherwise unchanged: the announce still raises on every verdict change (both directions) and the green round-trip still clears right after its own raise, so that clear always follows a raise. After the build the string 'validation-verdict-changed-' appears nowhere under cairn/ except proofs asserting its absence.
decisions.amended: 2026-09-16 by CC after rehearsal pass 1: both bodies recorded so the build is determinate under either answer to open-69cd989012c4

decisions.text: D7: THE STANDING CHECK. reseal.py gains a module-level set _RAISED_THIS_RUN: set[str]; each of the three raise sites (~:554 settled red, ~:604 timeout, ~:693 rung 3) adds identity after calling raise_trouble, and a clear discards it. def _stands_raised(raiser, identity, ladder) -> bool: True if ladder (an open reseal_ladder on the standing seal is the record that a rung-3 raise stood); else if the raiser has a callable diagnostic_trail() returning an existing directory, True iff the newest file (by filename, newest first) in that directory named *.raise_trouble.json or *.clear_trouble.json whose JSON 'pointer' equals identity is a raise_trouble (False if none); else (fixture raisers without a trail) True iff identity in _RAISED_THIS_RUN. It writes nothing and imports nothing from cairn/devices/trouble. Reading the trail first is what stops a double clear: the store's round-trip clear (D6) lands on disk before the ladder asks.

D8: THE PROOFS (red-first, one new file): cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_red_seal_is_one_trouble_from_raise_to_clear.py, scratch_dir fixtures only, fake raisers, the subject imported inside each tooth. Teeth: (1) the_store_and_the_ladder_spell_one_key — seal_trouble_identity exists in validation_store and equals reseal.trouble_identity for a proof, and announce_verdict_change through a recording device raises that same pointer; (2) siblings_carry_their_own_keys — two proofs in one component get distinct identities; (3) a_green_with_nothing_raised_clears_nothing — a fresh scratch proof sealed green, code moved, reseal green with a trail-less fake raiser: zero clears; (4) a_red_then_green_clears_once — reseal red (rung 3) then green: exactly one clear, same pointer as the raise; (5) a_trail_says_whether_it_stands — a fake raiser whose diagnostic_trail() is a scratch dir holding raise k then clear k: a green over a code move with no ladder emits no clear for k; with only raise k it emits one. The census (falsifier part 3) is a verdict instrument, not a tooth: over ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0, emissions after the build commit's time, every seal-red-* clear has an earlier raise of its pointer and no pointer has two clears without a raise between; no validation-verdict-changed-* emission after the bound.

D9: AMEND 86b6's PROOF. cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_siblings_green_does_not_clear_a_stale_proofs_trouble.py tooth 3's second half (fast2 green with nothing raised expects one clear) contradicts D2: it becomes fast2 sealed red via reseal (rung 3, raised), then green → raiser2.cleared == [trouble_identity(fast2)] while slow2 stays never sealed. Teeth 1 and 2 stand unchanged (per-proof keys + D2 satisfy them). Its docstring's per-component sentence is replaced by a pointer to ticket 87f0fc7b3514.

D10: MIGRATE THE OLD KEYS ONCE (a build step, scratch script, not code): for each identity standing raised in ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 (newest event a raise) that starts with 'validation-verdict-changed-' or is a per-component 'seal-red-<component>' key, emit ModuleRaiser('tester').clear_trouble(old, by='cc', what_changed='identity retired by 87f0fc7b3514: seal troubles are keyed per proof'); any proof still red in that component is caught by the next reseal under its per-proof key. Record the count before and after in the verdict.

D11: ONE IDENTITY PER PROOF, at the store's address. D3's question is answered (open-69cd989012c4: per proof). D1's 'inside cairn/devices/tester' predates validation_store's move to cairn/tools/validation_store/, so D1's one function lives there: def seal_trouble_identity(proof_path) -> str in cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py returns 'seal-red-' + the proof path relative to _REPO_ROOT (absolute when outside it), .py stripped, lowercased, every run of [^a-z0-9-] replaced by '-', stripped of '-' (e.g. seal-red-cairn-devices-tester-proofs-test-reseal-door). In cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py trouble_identity becomes 'trouble_identity = seal_trouble_identity' (imported beside the existing store import at :86), so every PROVED proof importing trouble_identity keeps working; its 'ONE TROUBLE PER COMPONENT' docstring goes. D2's predicate is D7.

intention: A red seal is one trouble under one identity from raise to clear, whoever turns it green.
why: Law 7: a raised trouble no clear can reach is a permanent error the record lies about — the log tree says ground-loop is red 7 times over while its seal is green. Law 6: the tester owns the seal, so it owns the one identity; two keys is two owners of one condition.
how: Measure first (done, n=1420 emissions in ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0): the ladder raises seal-red-<component> and clears it only when IT turns the seal green, and it also emits a clear for every green reseal with nothing raised (seal-red-cairn-tools-base: raised 4, cleared 145); the store raises and clears validation-verdict-changed-<proof> on its own round-trip; a hand seal (TesterDevice.run_proof by CC) clears the store's key and never the ladder's, so ground-loop stands raised 31 / cleared 24 and tree 11 / 7. Fix: one identity per proof, derived by one function both emitters import from the store side (base may not import the device; the store is the lower rung), keyed by the proof path; the raise names the proof, the clear names the same proof, and the ladder stops clearing what nothing raised. Then a fold-side proof: every raise in the log has at most one matching clear key, and the outstanding set after a hand seal is empty.
falsifier: DONE when (1) the tester's raise and clear of a seal trouble share ONE identity derived by one function at one address that both cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py and cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py call; (2) a proof under a temp log root asserts that a seal turned red by the ladder and green by a HAND seal (TesterDevice.run_proof) leaves nothing outstanding for cc, and that a green reseal with nothing raised emits no clear; (3) the raise/clear census over ~/.cairn/logs/tester/0 restricted to emissions after the build commit shows every raised identity cleared under the same key once its seal is green and no clear without a prior raise. RED if any clear is emitted for a key nothing raised, or if the two files still spell the identity separately. WRONG INTENT if the two keys were meant as two troubles (component-level roll-up vs per-proof) — then the fix is a recorded pairing between them, not a merge; the open question decides which.
